@bettina.kroll: Scheduled. The digest will post in #coastal-team every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time, covering the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus open customer items. Two caveats:

- The scheduler isn't running yet, so nothing will post until the Hermes gateway is started.
- The job runs at 13:00 UTC, which is 08:00 Chicago time only until the clocks change on Nov 1. After that it needs to move to 14:00 UTC.

The digest will leave out finance figures. Where an open item depends on a money term, it will point to June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve instead.
